gdp_yoy.source: MoSPI 'Provisional Estimates of Annual GDP for 2025-26 and Quarterly Estimates of GDP for Q4 (Jan-Mar) 2025-26' press release, base year 2022-23 series, released June 5, 2026. Q4 real GDP growth 7.8%, flat vs Q3's 7.8% and down from Q2's 8.4%; full-year FY26 at 7.7% (vs 7.1% in FY25).

cpi.source: MoSPI Consumer Price Index Press Release for May 2026 (provisional, base year 2024=100), released June 12, 2026. All-India CPI YoY inflation 3.93% (rural 4.25%, urban 3.53%); fifth straight monthly rise. CFPI (food) at 4.78%.

rate_cut_cycle.note: RBI MPC unanimously (6-0) held the repo rate at 5.25% on June 5, 2026, retaining its neutral stance — the same hold already reflected in the current production file. FY27 GDP growth forecast cut to 6.6% (from 6.9%) and inflation forecast raised to 5.1% (from 4.6%), citing West Asia conflict, elevated energy prices and monsoon/El Niño uncertainty. No new MPC meeting has occurred since.
rate_cut_cycle.source: RBI MPC Resolution, June 5, 2026 — repo rate held at 5.25%, neutral stance (via Forbes India and Sahi.com MPC coverage; rbi.org.in itself returned 403 to direct fetch).

gov_capex.note: Centre's capital expenditure for FY27 (2026-27) rose to ₹2.51 lakh crore in Apr-May 2026, from ₹2.21 lakh crore in the same period a year earlier (~13-20% YoY growth depending on measure) — about 21% of the full-year FY27 capex target of ₹12.22 lakh crore achieved in just the first two months. Fiscal deficit at 9.6% of the full-year target over the same period, consistent with a continued capex-led growth strategy despite a narrower buffer.
gov_capex.source: Controller General of Accounts (CGA) fiscal data for Apr-May 2026-27, reported via Business Standard / PIB coverage (~June 30, 2026).

china_plus_one.note: Manufacturing FDI grew 18% YoY in FY25 to USD 19.04 bn. India's March 2026 Press Note 2 amendments to Press Note 3 (2020) allow non-controlling stakes up to 10% by investors from land-bordering countries via automatic route, with a 60-day expedited approval process for Chinese investment in electronics, capital goods and solar cells. PLI scheme continues (836 applications approved, ₹2.16 lakh crore committed investment). No fresher official commentary than the June 2, 2026 BusinessToday analysis was found this cycle — same underlying trend confirmed, not a new data point.
china_plus_one.source: BusinessToday — 'Can China+1 help India create millions of jobs?' (June 2, 2026); Press Note 2, 2026 FDI policy amendments (March 2026).

rural_recovery.note: Southwest monsoon ran 42% below normal as of June 24, 2026, after the fifth-driest June since 1901 (39% below normal). Kharif sowing down 23% YoY (18.27m ha vs 23.65m ha as of June 25); paddy -25%, pulses -30%, oilseeds -53%. 41.2% of India's area was under drought/near-drought conditions as of July 1, 2026. IMD forecasts below-normal rainfall for most of the country in July, with only limited pockets (NW/NE, east-central, eastern peninsula) seeing normal-to-above-normal rain. Signal has deteriorated versus the prior cycle.
rural_recovery.source: IMD monsoon updates and Agriculture Ministry sowing data, via ETV Bharat and Business Standard/Down To Earth coverage (June 30 - July 1, 2026).
